purpose: Governed source identities for U.S. Employment Situation first-print actuals and doctoral-research market consensus. R4 authorizes governed research source-data ingestion only; it does not authorize model scoring, runtime promotion, direction voting, or forecast/decision writes.
point_in_time_rule: For any event at t, a model input is eligible only when provider semantics support that it is a pre-release consensus associated with that event. When exact pre-release update time is not proven, reconstructed consensus is eligible no earlier than the official BLS release timestamp. Current-vintage substitution for historical first-print actuals or post-result provider switching is forbidden.

coverage_contract.complete_case_rule: All three Investing.com consensus fields must be present for an event. Missing consensus is fail-closed; no imputation, carry-forward, model forecast substitution, or provider switching is permitted.

consensus_provider_policy.professional_benchmark_if_entitled: Bloomberg Economic Calendar historical latest pre-release panel consensus
forbidden_substitutes: per-origin provider switching after viewing model results
post-release consensus invented from another provider
current-vintage BLS/FRED value substituted for historical first print
consensus_provider_policy.investing_forecast_semantic: Forecast/Consensus = consensus estimate from economists before the data is released, per Investing.com Economic Calendar FAQ
consensus_provider_policy.investing_availability_semantics: Unless exact pre-release forecast-update timestamp is separately proven, preserved historical consensus is eligible no earlier than the official BLS release timestamp and must be tagged PRE_RELEASE_CONSENSUS_PRESERVED_ON_INVESTING_CALENDAR_RESEARCH_RECONSTRUCTION.
consensus_provider_policy.storage_policy: Research-only normalized fields and provenance metadata only; do not commit raw Investing.com HTML or bulk page content to the public repository; no redistribution; seek permission or replace provider before external/commercial deployment.
consensus_provider_policy.legal_classification_note: USER_ACCEPTED_LICENSE_RISK is a project governance label, not a legal conclusion. Investing.com terms currently restrict use/storage without prior written permission.

MACRO_NFP_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.semantic: BLS Employment Situation first-published total nonfarm payroll employment monthly change
MACRO_NFP_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis ALFRED / U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
MACRO_NFP_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.availability_policy: official BLS release timestamp at 08:30 America/New_York
MACRO_NFP_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.revision_policy: derive headline change from PAYEMS current-month and previous-month levels visible in ALFRED as of the release date; later revisions must not replace the release-date reconstruction

MACRO_UNEMP_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.semantic: BLS Employment Situation first-published unemployment rate
MACRO_UNEMP_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis ALFRED / U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
MACRO_UNEMP_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.availability_policy: official BLS release timestamp at 08:30 America/New_York
MACRO_UNEMP_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.revision_policy: use UNRATE value visible in ALFRED as of the release date; later revisions/current vintage must not replace it

MACRO_AHE_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.semantic: BLS Employment Situation first-published average hourly earnings month-over-month change for all employees on private nonfarm payrolls
MACRO_AHE_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis ALFRED / U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
MACRO_AHE_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.availability_policy: official BLS release timestamp at 08:30 America/New_York
MACRO_AHE_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.revision_policy: derive from current and previous AHE levels visible in ALFRED as of release date and round to the BLS-published one-decimal MoM convention

MACRO_NFP_CONSENSUS_PIT.semantic: Investing.com preserved pre-release economist consensus for headline NFP change associated with the Employment Situation release
MACRO_NFP_CONSENSUS_PIT.availability_policy: eligible no earlier than official BLS release timestamp unless exact pre-release update time is separately proven

MACRO_UNEMP_CONSENSUS_PIT.semantic: Investing.com preserved pre-release economist consensus for unemployment rate associated with the Employment Situation release
MACRO_UNEMP_CONSENSUS_PIT.availability_policy: eligible no earlier than official BLS release timestamp unless exact pre-release update time is separately proven

MACRO_AHE_CONSENSUS_PIT.semantic: Investing.com preserved pre-release economist consensus for average hourly earnings month-over-month change associated with the Employment Situation release
MACRO_AHE_CONSENSUS_PIT.availability_policy: eligible no earlier than official BLS release timestamp unless exact pre-release update time is separately proven
